checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=7 breakdowns=5 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=1.63 tightness=9.98 base_volume_vs_leg=2.23 base_volume_vs_avg=3.05
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: 5 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 1.63 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close -60.2% vs its 20-SMA, -70.0% over 20 sessions
gain of 75.69% is 15% or more: the worst cell in the only event study, a 36% win rate and -9.3% at 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)
first leg of 26.7% in 10 sessions: his '15% plus in 10 days or less'

claude.reason: The base is catastrophically loose: 5 breakdowns inside a 7-session window, a giveback of 1.63x the leg, and tightness of 9.98 against a 1.0 threshold — the shaded box on the chart shows a violent, wide-ranging collapse from ~$12 to ~$1.60 with no orderly consolidation whatsoever. The burst bar itself is not the widest of the last five sessions (RE FAIL, vs_prior_5=0.39), meaning there is no genuine range expansion. The 75.69% single-day gain on a sub-$5 stock that has been in freefall looks like a catalyst or halt-related event, not a momentum burst from a quiet base.
claude.key_risk: The 'base' is a downtrend collapse, not a consolidation; any follow-through is speculative and the prior breakout record is 1 of 4.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst close of $3.18 or if the stock gaps up more than 5% without any orderly pre-market consolidation.
